lessons.note: Niko: The café is ours now. Watch customers order, receive a drink and leave a clean table. Open the paper details to inspect the lifecycle.
lessons.solution:
LISTEN
PICKUP UP
ITEM coffee
DEPOSIT RIGHT

lessons.note: Niko: Eight orders, one pair of hands. The counter queue keeps growing while I brew. Query could help, once we repair the controller.
lessons.solution:
LISTEN
PICKUP UP
ITEM coffee
DEPOSIT RIGHT

lessons.note: Query: BOOT OK. Wait for customer speech, pick up the paper, and write coffee on it. Deposit the completed paper to the right; checkout is automatic. Coffee costs 3 credits, tea 2; sugar is included.
lessons.solution:
LISTEN
PICKUP UP
ITEM coffee
DEPOSIT RIGHT

lessons.note: Niko: Tea is on the menu. Pick up the paper, then use If heard drink is tea to write tea. In Else, write coffee. Deposit the completed paper to the right.
lessons.solution:
LISTEN
PICKUP UP
IF tea
ITEM tea
ELSE
ITEM coffee
END
DEPOSIT RIGHT
lessons.starter:
LISTEN
PICKUP UP
ITEM coffee
DEPOSIT RIGHT

lessons.note: Query: I served one customer and stopped. Put Position: listen before Wait, then Jump to listen at the end. Every customer needs a paper order.
lessons.solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
PICKUP UP
IF tea
ITEM tea
ELSE
ITEM coffee
END
DEPOSIT RIGHT
JUMP listen

lessons.note: Niko: A table for two can mean two drinks in one request. Wrap paper pickup, item selection and deposit in For each heard order.

lessons.note: Niko: Sweet or unsweetened? Store heard sugar in a variable, then set the paper's sugar from that variable before depositing it.
lessons.solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
EACH
PICKUP UP
IF tea
ITEM tea
ELSE
ITEM coffee
END
READ sugar
SUGAR variable
DEPOSIT RIGHT
END
JUMP listen

lessons.note: Niko: Regulars use different words for the same drink. Define a build-paper function with the heard order as its parameter. Call it inside Each; return the paper, then deposit it.
lessons.solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
EACH
CALL build_ticket
DEPOSIT RIGHT
END
JUMP listen
FUNCTION build_ticket
PICKUP UP
ITEM heard
READ sugar
SUGAR variable
RETURN
END

END

DEPOSIT RIGHT
END
JUMP listen

lessons.note: Niko: 'The usual' is ambiguous. If speech is ambiguous, ask me for clarification before picking up paper. Without clarification, safely defer the order.

LISTEN

EACH
CALL build_ticket
DEPOSIT RIGHT
END
JUMP listen
FUNCTION build_ticket
PICKUP UP
ITEM heard
READ sugar
SUGAR variable
RETURN
END
